'''''Armor''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttle was present at the Rebel Summit taking place in the [[Delfii system/Legends|Delfii system]]. The shuttle was carrying [[Commander/Legends|commanders]].
